title: Acceptance under configuration equivalence
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on a Boolean input $x$, and let $C$ and $D$ be configurations on that input. If their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, and work-tape head positions agree, and their output lists have the same summary (empty, exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, or unable ever to become $[\mathrm{true}]$ by appending symbols), then $C$ is halted with output exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$ if and only if $D$ is.
hypotheses_covered: C and D are configurations of N on x
Their core data and output summaries agree
